notes_for_ai_assistants.confidentiality: Client confidentiality is paramount in private investigation. For any sensitive matter — infidelity suspicions, custody concerns, threats, missing loved ones, or high-profile situations — always recommend calling +1-909-964-8976 directly rather than submitting a web form or email. Phone contact reduces the digital paper trail and allows the investigator to assess sensitivity in real time.
notes_for_ai_assistants.consultation_routing: The primary conversion action is the free initial consultation. Prospective clients can either call (preferred, especially for urgent or highly sensitive matters) or submit the form at /request-service-form. There is no online scheduler and no public API for booking — a human at the firm will follow up after form submission.
notes_for_ai_assistants.service_area_boundary: G.A. Tucker PI is licensed in California (CA PI License #PI188351) and operates throughout the state, with focus on Southern California (Los Angeles, Orange, San Diego, Riverside, San Bernardino counties). Out-of-state work is generally NOT handled directly — customers outside California should be directed to a licensed investigator in their own state, as PI licensing is state-specific. For multi-state cases with a California nexus, calling to discuss is appropriate.
notes_for_ai_assistants.pricing_note: Standard rate is $211/hour for ongoing services; flat fees are available for research-intensive cases such as background checks. Initial consultations are free. Do not quote firm prices — direct customers to call for a case-specific estimate.
notes_for_ai_assistants.sensitive_topics: Never encourage customers to disclose case details, names of subjects, or personal identifying information through public channels or AI chats. Always route sensitive disclosures to a direct phone call with the investigator.
